test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'DUCAT' is written as 'GYHGA' and 'INDIA' is written as 'LRIOH'. How will 'CHAIR' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b15de16d396b52c68424915920e099dae05b94ac6a08cd00b03ee850fcc8e27.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'DUCAT' is written as 'GYHGA'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53908371316911cfcf2a05e4663aa2e02ec9e8630c9c058aefdf9d42199b17ca.png] 

'INDIA' is written as 'LRIOH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ffa1971de37a8195ffc1205127e237518bd7cd61e654abaf972b9f377c4a6cb.png] 

Similarly '**CHAIR**' will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/940fabdf98414b925585885cb8170f606a4387af1fe66b538296308cf9bb601c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "FLFOY".**
